recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-12585 unless a future Patient Care decision changes the Goal.target measure/detail relationship.
issue_request: FHIR-12585 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for FHIR-core Goal asking to add an invariant that Goal.target.measure is required if Goal.target.detail is populated.
initial_application: The request was historically applied in git-svn commit 2638ed458ab0a9efb362e6b1f77d2d6743edeb25, whose subject says preapplied #12585 added Goal.target invariant and whose patch added the invariant to source/goal/goal-spreadsheet.xml and source/goal/goal-spreadsheet.sheet.txt. The invariant was retained through later source conversion into source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini. Later commit 55512f8e09be7228efab289f8bf660242d29654d for FHIR-24860 cleaned up invariant condition metadata but preserved gol-1 and its expression. Broad Jira search found FHIR-34180, but it is Waiting for Input and concerns summary flags rather than this invariant. Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive human discussion or conflicting later decision for FHIR-12585.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Goal StructureDefinition defines gol-1 on Goal.target with human text 'Goal.target.measure is required if Goal.target.detail is populated' and FHIRPath '(detail.exists() and measure.exists()) or detail.exists().not()', equivalent to the requested implication. Goal.target.measure and Goal.target.detail[x] carry condition gol-1, and an existing fail fixture covers detail without measure.

related_jiras.note: Later invariant cleanup changed condition metadata around Goal.target but preserved the gol-1 constraint semantics relevant to FHIR-12585.
Appeared in broad Jira search because it also mentions Goal summary flags, but it is Waiting for Input and does not affect the target measure/detail invariant decision.
